executionRules: One run = one process = one dedicated corpus, build cache and output directory under the run state root.
A scenario run is measured after a successful baseline build; the baseline is reported separately as prepare and is never counted as the scenario.
A new process starts a cold Node worker, so a cache hit in a fresh process is recorded as such and is not called a warm worker.
Timeouts kill the owned process tree and are recorded as status=timeout; the run directory and raw stdout/stderr stay on disk and a retry uses a new run index.
-Resume skips only runs already recorded as completed; it never rewrites or deletes earlier records.
The published 1.0.0 harness (B0) has no --scenario switch, so its job unit is the whole sequence; the runner records one entry per measured scenario from that process.
conditionsRecordedPerRun: process: fresh per run; the B0 markdown job unit runs all four scenarios in one process (same-process sequence)
product cache: cold for clean/cold; warm for no-op and edit scenarios after the prepare build
worker: cold start for mdx cold; reused inside the process for the following mdx scenarios
OS page cache: not controlled; reported as process-cold, not OS-cold
notCoveredByThisTask: CLI E2E and Watch E2E measurements (plan §5.3) need the CLI/tool harness; V110-13 adds serve control and the Watch E2E runner is part of the V110-25 matrix.

Phase-level attribution inside SiteGenerator (input scan/hash, plan build, cache load, parse/render, staging) is not instrumented in the product; V110-04 attributes it with scenario deltas, engine micro-benchmarks and measured micro-costs, and V110-05/06 may add explicit counters where the deltas are too coarse.
